Suspicious Merchant Monitoring
Track merchant and branch warnings, closures, and reactivations independently from the existing pages.
Counting rules: Merchant ID identifies the merchant; Branch ID identifies a specific branch. Action Scope distinguishes Branch from Merchant-Wide. Historical rows should be retained when a status changes so warning → closure → reactivation trends remain measurable. Merchant-wide actions are counted separately from branch-level actions.

Social Media Monitoring & Credit Liquidation Prevention
Track page observations, unique customers by National ID, preventive actions and distinct credit exposure
Calculation rule: Every customer observation is retained to track activity over time. Unique customers are counted by National ID; credit exposure is counted once per National ID, using the earliest dated observation. Customer records and suspicious pages are reported independently because no direct relationship is maintained between them. Exposure is an estimate of risk avoided, not realized cash recovery.
